what_it_shows: Reservation messages from the CRS and channels validated, with error queues reviewed daily; night audit and folio processing in the brand PMS under change control; CRS-to-PMS reservation reconciliation is a weekly manual report with no daily automated exception alerts; rate, fee and reservation delivery reports for channels and client PMSs; reservation and folio data backed up

title: Guest privacy and SL-2 client operations records
source_system: Privacy request portal; booking engine consent logs; SL-2 client admin console; client status page
what_it_shows: Marketing consent captured separately from booking, with consent logs; access and correction requests tracked in the privacy request portal; complaint log; privacy notice versions on client booking pages; register of unauthorized disclosures; records of processing for SL-2 client data; no automated log of data sent to channels per guest; client administrators request and approve their users, with no periodic attestation; client status page history; data quality reports

title: BIA interviews: reservations, hotel operations, payments, technology and integration owners
source_system: Interviews (Vice President, Distribution and Reservations; Executive Vice President, Hotel Operations; Director of Payments and PCI Compliance; Vice President, Hotel Technology; Vice President, Food and Beverage; Vice President, Franchise Technology Services; Vice President, Integration Management Office)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, third parties and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say it can tolerate; owners cite the reach of the CRS to all 750 hotels, online travel agencies closing availability after about 4 hours, guest room access, franchise and client availability commitments, and the transition services agreement terms for the resorts

title: BIA interviews: commercial, digital, revenue, finance and HR owners
source_system: Interviews (Chief Commercial Officer; Vice President, Digital and Loyalty; Vice President, Revenue Strategy; Controller; Chief Human Resources Officer)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, dependencies, workaround and tolerable outage and data loss; the Controller cites the quarter-end SEC filing window; the revenue strategy lead states that rates can be held at the last published values for several days

title: BIA dependency and contract review
source_system: Vendor contracts; DR and failover test records; hub, carrier and vendor test logs
what_it_shows: Contract RTOs, alternates and last test dates for 26 dependencies, including the hub, SD-WAN and guest Wi-Fi and IPTV failover tests on 2026-05-30 and the Cloud provider B data platform and ERP recovery tests on 2026-06-20; 15 dependencies are single points of failure overall or per hotel, and 9 have no test on record

title: Risk analysis workshops
source_system: Workshops (SOC; Payments; Hotel Technology; Network Engineering; Franchise Technology Compliance; Integration Management Office; Digital and Loyalty; Revenue Strategy; Third-Party Risk; Finance)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past incidents, near misses and threat scenarios in their areas, and the existing controls they rely on

title: Loyalty fraud loss report, 2026 Q2
source_system: Loyalty fraud team reporting
what_it_shows: Fraudulent points redemptions after account takeover cost about $1.9 million in 2026 Q2

title: Gap analysis interviews with control owners
source_system: Interviews (CISO; Director of Payments and PCI Compliance; Chief Privacy Officer; General Counsel; Director of Security Operations; Director of Identity and Access Management; Director of Network Engineering; Director of Third-Party Risk Management; Director of Franchise Technology Compliance; Vice President, Distribution and Reservations; Vice President, Digital and Loyalty)
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each requirement is carried out today and where the records are kept

title: Gap analysis analytics and samples: accounts, permissions, workforce
source_system: PMS permission report; franchise portal account export; certification records; learning system; background check records
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
what_it_shows: Full analytics of about 36,500 PMS accounts: 1,340 users hold the full card display permission against about 420 needed by role design (about 920 accounts over); 1,912 franchisee accounts inactive more than 90 days still enabled; 2026 Q2 quarterly franchisee certifications not complete at 38 of 741 hotels. Samples: 60 of about 12,000 training records complete; 25 of 46 vault and payments staff had a background check before access; no exceptions in either sample

title: Gap analysis samples: endpoints, releases, changes, scans and recurring reviews
source_system: EDR console; legacy POS workstations; pipeline reports; change records; scan reports; SIEM health alerts; PCI program records
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
what_it_shows: EDR on 60 of 60 sampled endpoints; vendor anti-malware on 25 of 25 sampled legacy POS workstations reported to no central console; 25 of 25 sampled releases had pipeline security testing; 40 of 212 changes sampled with no exceptions; internal rescans of legacy POS critical findings completed after target in 2 of 4 quarters; 4 quarters of passing ASV scans and wireless scans; 14 of 14 SIEM control failure alerts responded to; 11 targeted risk analyses, 4 quarterly service provider reviews and scope confirmations of 2026-01 and 2026-07 on file; risk committee minutes for 4 quarters; the 12.10.7 case record for the mailbox card data shows the purge not complete 60 days after it started

title: Gap analysis configuration review: firewall rules, payment pages, vendor access and log sources
source_system: Firewall rule analytics; hotel network configurations; payment page inventory; PAM and MFA reports; legacy POS service account review; SIEM log source inventory
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
what_it_shows: 1 of 2,340 hub and hotel firewall rules let franchised segments reach the CRS integration tier (removed 2026-06-02, removal not yet verified); legacy POS servers share segments with back office PCs at 9 of 41 legacy hotels; 3 of 4 payment pages (the resort microsites) have no company WAF rules, script inventory or monitoring; 5 of 14 property-system vendors connect without company MFA, including legacy POS vendor sessions into the 41 legacy POS servers; legacy POS service accounts at all 41 servers use hardcoded passwords not changed since installation; 50 of 312 PPP log sources (41 legacy POS servers and the 9 resorts' systems) do not reach the SIEM, and automated review rules do not cover them

title: Gap analysis walk-throughs and recurring log samples at hotels
source_system: 10 company-operated hotels (observation); legacy outlet inspection logs; hotel controller review sign-offs
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
what_it_shows: Badge access to hotel IT rooms and visitor logs as recorded at the 10 hotels visited; printed card authorization forms kept in unlocked drawers at 4 of the 10; device inspections at legacy outlets missed in 7 of 25 sampled weeks and device lists incomplete at 5 hotels; local legacy POS report reviews missed in 6 of 25 sampled weeks (same selections as P07 SR-9 and AU-6)

title: Gap analysis contract and vendor analytics
source_system: Contract repository analytics; vendor register; vendor contract sample
what_it_shows: 3 of 86 card-data and personal-data vendors had no current AOC (legacy POS vendor, one lock vendor, the seller's hosting provider); 212 of 640 franchise agreements lack the PCI DSS acknowledgment and incident notice timing terms, and all 180 SL-2 agreements carry them; 25 of 86 sampled vendor contracts carry the 72-hour notice term; no contract or procedure routes franchisee incident reports to the disclosure committee

title: Price display, fee and call tests, 2026-07
source_system: Booking engine, app, chatbot and resort microsite quotes; channel feed analytics; contact center call recordings
what_it_shows: 60 of 60 website and app quotes and 60 of 60 bookings showed the total price and the final amount; 15 of 40 chatbot and microsite quotes omitted the resort fee (9 of 20 chatbot quotes for resort collection hotels, and the quotes from all 3 resort microsites); fee codes missing for 14 resort and urban hotels in one global distribution system feed; 3 of 25 sampled booking calls quoted the base rate first without the total; resort microsites show the resort fee inside 'taxes and fees'

title: AI portfolio review and use case tests, August 2026
source_system: AI governance committee meeting of 2026-08-19; AI-001 back-test and quote parity test; AI-002 test sets, prompt-injection attempts and transcript checks
what_it_shows: AI-001: 7.8% average 14-day forecast error; in a back-test of 2025 Florida hurricane declarations, auto-published rates at 9 company-operated hotels rose up to 31% above the 30-day average before revenue managers froze them by hand (median 26 hours); 120 parity quotes with no unexplained differences; pooling active for 322 hotels. AI-002: 93% correct on the 200-question set (English 94%, Spanish 87%); 9 of 20 quotes for resort collection hotels omitted the resort fee; 18 of 20 accessibility, medical and emergency questions handed to staff; system instructions partly revealed in 2 of 30 prompt-injection attempts; card numbers redacted before storage since 2026-07, with older transcripts not yet purged. AI-006 ranking disabled 2026-08-20

title: Control assessment: Account management samples
source_system: Identity governance workflows; PMS user export; franchise portal approvals; HR termination records; PMS Tenant Administration Manager interview
what_it_shows: 60 sampled account events matched approved requests, role templates and BS-TECH-02 franchise approvals; 3 of 60 sampled terminations (all at resorts) were disabled 2 to 9 days late; resort account managers learn of terminations only from manual tickets; 1,912 franchisee accounts inactive more than 90 days were enabled; 2026 Q2 franchisee user attestations not completed at 38 of 741 hotels

title: Control assessment: Inactive account analytic
source_system: Identity governance inactivity rules; franchise portal account export; last sign-in data (about 36,500 PMS accounts and 46 vault administrator accounts)
what_it_shows: Workforce rules disable expired, orphaned and policy-violating accounts and the analytic found none enabled; 1,912 franchisee accounts inactive more than 90 days were enabled; the franchise portal had no disable rule

title: Control assessment: Access enforcement tests
source_system: PMS role matrix; tokenization service authorization policy; 25 PMS users; 3 unapproved service identities
what_it_shows: No sampled user reached another hotel's data; detokenization requests from unapproved service identities were denied and alerted

title: Control assessment: Least privilege analytic and PAM session sample
source_system: PMS permission report; PAM session records (25 of 1,640); role design
what_it_shows: Sampled PAM sessions were approved and time-limited; the PMS full card display permission is held by 1,340 users against a role design that needs about 420

title: Control assessment: Remote access review
source_system: STD-02.3; remote access inventory; hotel firewall rules; Vice President, Hotel Technology interview
what_it_shows: STD-02.3 documents each remote access type; 5 of 14 vendors reach property systems at 37 hotels through vendor-managed tools with standing accounts, not authorized per session through PAM; tools were enabled outside approved windows at 11 of the 37 hotels

title: Control assessment: Training records and phishing results
source_system: Learning system reports; training content; phishing results; 10 front office staff interviews
what_it_shows: 60 sampled training records complete at hire and annually (98.6% completion); content updated 2026-02; 6 months of monthly phishing simulations ran

title: Control assessment: Event logging test
source_system: Logging standard STD-01.4; SIEM parsing; 6 test events
what_it_shows: All 6 test events were logged and parsed with the required fields; event list reviewed 2026-03

title: Control assessment: Audit review records and log source check
source_system: SOC case records; log source inventory; hotel controller review sign-offs; Director of Security Operations interview
what_it_shows: SOC findings reported to the incident commander and the CISO; 50 of 312 log sources (41 legacy POS servers and the 9 resorts' seller systems) do not reach the SIEM; local weekly reviews were missed in 6 of 25 sampled weeks

title: Control assessment: Log archive protection test
source_system: Log archive account policies; alert records; deletion attempt with an audit test account
what_it_shows: Deletion attempt blocked and alerted to the SOC

title: Control assessment: Retention settings inspection
source_system: Log archive retention settings
what_it_shows: 12 months retained with 3 months immediately available; 7 years for SOX-relevant sources

title: Control assessment: Audit generation check
source_system: Component logging settings; sample records from 6 components
what_it_shows: Records generated with the required content on all 6 components; the legacy POS server generates records locally only

title: Control assessment: Assessor independence review
source_system: Internal audit charter; QSA selection records; engagement letters; conflict declarations; audit committee minutes (6 engagements)
what_it_shows: Independence in 2026 rested on case-by-case decisions: the co-source firm's consulting arm configured the PAM tool in 2025 and the 2025 QSA firm designed segmentation fixes; no written rule in the charter or the QSA selection procedure

title: Control assessment: Penetration and segmentation test review
source_system: Penetration and segmentation test reports; GRC test calendar (3 required tests)
what_it_shows: Annual tests were done 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-22; the service provider segmentation test due in 2025 H2 was not performed

title: Control assessment: Baseline comparison
source_system: Infrastructure-as-code baselines; PMS tenant security settings; cloud POS profile; legacy POS build documents; 25 components
what_it_shows: Baselines for cloud components, PMS tenant settings and cloud POS reviewed 2026-04 and updated with each release; no current baseline for legacy POS servers and workstations at 41 hotels, where the vendor's 2019 build document is the latest; legacy POS configurations are changed by the vendor outside configuration control

title: Control assessment: Change sample
source_system: Change tickets; change advisory board minutes; deployment logs; 40 of 212 changes; Payments Platform Engineering Manager interview
what_it_shows: All 40 sampled changes had risk ratings, testing, approval and back-out plans; the board meets weekly

title: Control assessment: Configuration compliance scans
source_system: STD-01.5 hardening settings; compliance scan results; exception register
what_it_shows: Settings documented and monitored for cloud components, PCs and firewalls (97% compliance); 31 lock servers and the legacy POS servers deviate from the hardening standard; lock server deviations have no approved exception, while legacy POS deviations are covered by EXC-2026-011

title: Control assessment: Inventory trace
source_system: CMDB; PCI DSS in-scope inventory; terminal management export; hotel device lists; 60 devices at 8 hotels
what_it_shows: Inventory reconciled quarterly with no duplicates; payment terminal lists at 5 of 41 legacy hotels were incomplete (14 terminals missing)

title: Control assessment: Card data location review
source_system: Cardholder data flow diagram v7; data discovery reports; mailbox permissions; scan re-performed on 10 mailboxes
what_it_shows: Card data locations are documented in the data flow diagram; about 4,800 emails with card numbers (390 with security codes) in group sales and events mailboxes at managed hotels sit outside the documented storage locations; users with access to those mailboxes were not identified or limited

title: Control assessment: Contingency plan review
source_system: PPP contingency plan v3; resort transition services agreement; 4 interviews
what_it_shows: Plan covers the vault, PMS tenant and hotel downtime procedures with roles, contacts and BIA objectives; the 9 resorts follow the seller's plan (24-hour RTO, nightly backups); the plan was not updated for the resort acquisition 14 months after closing

title: Control assessment: DR test review
source_system: DR test report 2026-04-25; corrective action log
what_it_shows: The test met its objectives (vault restore 1.8 hours); results reviewed and actions tracked

title: Control assessment: Backup sample and restore observation
source_system: Backup job logs (25 of 181); immutability settings; key escrow records; 1 restore observed
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled jobs succeeded; backups encrypted and immutable; restore observed

title: Control assessment: Recovery and reconstitution review
source_system: DR test report; transition services agreement
what_it_shows: Cloud PPP components reconstituted to a known state in the DR test; resort PMS recovery depends on the seller's 24-hour RTO against the BIA RTO of 8 hours, and its restore has not been tested

title: Control assessment: Sign-in sample
source_system: Identity platform logs; 25 sign-ins
what_it_shows: Every sampled sign-in was a unique identity with MFA

title: Control assessment: Privileged MFA check
source_system: PAM configuration; FIDO2 enrollment report (64 accounts)
what_it_shows: All 64 privileged accounts require FIDO2 keys through PAM

title: Control assessment: Authenticator and default credential tests
source_system: Password standard; PAM rotation report; default-credential tests on the 41 legacy POS servers (vendor approval, after outlet hours)
what_it_shows: Authenticator issuance, strength and protection managed; vendor default credentials were active on legacy POS back-office servers at 3 hotels (reported to the CISO 2026-08-12; changed 2026-08-14); legacy POS service accounts at 41 hotels use hardcoded passwords not changed since installation

title: Control assessment: Incident handling sample
source_system: SOC case records; SOAR playbooks; post-incident reports; 25 of 286 incidents
what_it_shows: Sampled incidents were handled through all phases, coordinated with contingency plans, with lessons learned applied

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting sample and staff interviews
source_system: Case timestamps (25 incidents); 20 staff interviews at 4 hotels
what_it_shows: Sampled incidents were reported within 1 hour; the staff interviewed knew how to report

title: Control assessment: Incident response plan and materiality playbook review
source_system: Incident response plan v6; materiality playbook v2; disclosure committee roster and minutes; interviews with the General Counsel, CFO, CISO, Director of Payments and PCI Compliance and Director of Franchise Technology Compliance
what_it_shows: Plan includes card brand, acquirer and SEC steps, defines reportable incidents and is protected; it does not address incidents that start at a franchised hotel or affect only franchisee guests; plan and playbook not updated after 3 disclosure committee members changed in 2026, and the new members were not briefed

title: Control assessment: Nonlocal maintenance review
source_system: PAM vendor session records (25 of 1,420); hotel firewall rules; vendor remote tool inventory
what_it_shows: Sampled PAM vendor sessions were approved and recorded; sessions through the 5 vendor-managed tools are not monitored by the company and do not use company MFA; tools and their connections were left enabled after maintenance windows at 11 of 37 hotels

title: Control assessment: Termination sample
source_system: HR records; identity governance logs; resort service desk tickets; 60 of 1,318 terminations (same sample as AC-2)
what_it_shows: 3 of 60 sampled terminations, all at the 9 resorts, were disabled 2 to 9 days late against a same-business-day standard; credentials revoked, exit steps done and property retrieved for the sample

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: P01 risk register; targeted risk analyses
what_it_shows: The 2026 enterprise risk analysis is complete, integrated with ERM, reviewed and disseminated; targeted risk analyses on file

title: Control assessment: Vulnerability finding sample
source_system: Scan reports; remediation tickets; ASV attestations; 60 of 1,860 findings
what_it_shows: Scanning cadence met and results analyzed and shared; 11 of 60 sampled critical findings on legacy POS servers exceeded the 30-day remediation target

title: Control assessment: External service review
source_system: Vendor register; AOC and SOC report reviews; franchise AOC tracker; Director of Third-Party Risk Management interview
what_it_shows: Oversight roles and vendor security terms defined; 3 of 86 vendors (legacy POS vendor, one lock vendor, the seller's hosting provider) had no current AOC; 141 of 640 franchised hotels did not submit a 2025 AOC and no default notices were issued; no technical visibility into 230 hotels off the managed network

title: Control assessment: Unsupported component review
source_system: Unsupported component register; vendor support notices
what_it_shows: 31 lock servers and legacy POS workstations at 6 hotels run operating systems out of vendor support; extended support and isolation documented for the POS workstations (EXC-2026-011)

title: Control assessment: Boundary review and reachability test
source_system: Firewall rule review (2,340 rules); segmentation test 2026-05; co-source reachability test from a franchised hotel segment in the network lab
what_it_shows: External interfaces monitored and controlled, with public components in separate subnetworks; the hub rule letting franchised segments reach the CRS integration tier on 2 ports was removed 2026-06-02 and its removal not yet verified; legacy POS servers share segments with back office PCs at 9 hotels

title: Control assessment: Transmission protection test
source_system: TLS scan of PPP interfaces; co-source packet captures at 2 legacy hotels using test cards
what_it_shows: Interfaces use TLS 1.2 or higher; the legacy POS sends unencrypted card data between workstations and the on-property server (confirmed at 2 hotels)

title: Control assessment: Key management review
source_system: Key ceremony records; HSM logs (2025-07 to 2026-06)
what_it_shows: Keys generated in HSMs with split knowledge and dual control

title: Control assessment: Encryption at rest inspection
source_system: Vault database and backup encryption settings
what_it_shows: Vault data encrypted with HSM-protected keys; tokens used elsewhere

title: Control assessment: Patch sample
source_system: Patch records; test records; 25 of 238 patches
what_it_shows: Flaws identified, reported and tested before installation through change control; legacy POS and lock server patches applied on vendor schedules, and 4 of 25 sampled patches were installed after 30 days

title: Control assessment: Monitoring coverage and alert tests
source_system: SOC coverage map; EDR reports; SOC alert tests at 2 hotels
what_it_shows: Monitoring objectives, analysis, legal review and reporting in place; legacy POS workstations at 41 hotels have no EDR; sessions through the 5 vendor-managed remote tools are not visible to the SOC

title: Control assessment: Integrity monitoring review
source_system: FIM configuration and alerts; payment page script monitoring (4 payment pages)
what_it_shows: FIM on the vault, tokenization service and booking engine payment form, with alert response; no integrity monitoring on legacy POS software; no script inventory or tamper detection on the 3 resort booking microsites

title: Control assessment: Device inspection log sample
source_system: Inspection logs (25 of 52 weeks at legacy outlets); tamper-evident seal checks
what_it_shows: Inspections at legacy outlets were missed in 7 of 25 sampled weeks
